description: Source code for Android device and WebView management in Playwright, including classes for Android, AndroidDevice, AndroidSocket, AndroidInput, and AndroidWebView, with methods for device control, WebView handling, and WebSocket connections.

classes.name: Android
classes.description: Represents an Android environment, capable of connecting to devices and launching servers.

classes.name: AndroidDevice
classes.description: Represents an Android device, managing WebViews and device interactions.

classes.name: AndroidSocket
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket connection to an Android device.

classes.name: AndroidInput
classes.description: Provides input actions like type, press, tap, swipe, and drag on Android devices.

classes.name: AndroidWebView
classes.description: Represents a WebView within an Android device, allowing access to its page.

methods.name: setDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets the default timeout for device operations.

methods.name: devices
methods.description: Retrieves connected Android devices.

methods.name: launchServer
methods.description: Launches an Android server if supported.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to an Android device over WebSocket.

methods.name: serial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the device.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Returns the model of the device.

methods.name: webViews
methods.description: Returns list of WebViews on the device.

methods.name: webView
methods.description: Finds a WebView matching criteria or waits for one.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for a specific Android selector condition.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills a text input in Android device.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key on the device.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap on a UI element.

methods.name: drag
methods.description: Performs a drag action.

methods.name: fling
methods.description: Performs a fling gesture.

methods.name: longTap
methods.description: Performs a long tap gesture.

methods.name: pinchClose
methods.description: Performs a pinch close gesture.

methods.name: pinchOpen
methods.description: Performs a pinch open gesture.

methods.name: scroll
methods.description: Scrolls in a direction.

methods.name: swipe
methods.description: Swipes in a direction.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a UI element.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the device.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the device connection.

methods.name: shell
methods.description: Executes a shell command.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a socket connection.

methods.name: installApk
methods.description: Installs an APK file.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes a file to the device.

methods.name: launchBrowser
methods.description: Launches a browser in the device.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event.
